name: io.github.AnOversizedMooseWithSocks/lecore
description: leCore: 2,400+ deterministic NumPy faculties behind one engine -- tiered capability search that refuses honestly, typed decisions that learn from reported outcomes, persistent memory, studied trees with citations, 3-D scenes and images as image blocks, and gated studio control (leStudio / leStudio3d).

environment_variables.name: LECORE_MCP_PROFILE
environment_variables.description: minimal | standard | full -- how many tools to expose (8 / 30 / 47)

environment_variables.name: LESTUDIO3D_URL
environment_variables.description: the 3-D studio's URL; its tools appear only when reachable

environment_variables.name: LESTUDIO_URL
environment_variables.description: the 2-D studio's URL; its tools appear only when reachable

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> when the server was started with --token
